cap: Each anterior axis runs from a hypothalamic hormone, through portal blood, to a pituitary cell, its hormone and a target. Four signals stimulate; prolactin is the exception, held down tonically by dopamine. Acidophils make GH and prolactin, while basophils make TSH, ACTH, LH and FSH. The posterior lobe makes nothing itself: ADH and oxytocin are made in the supraoptic and paraventricular nuclei and travel down axons.
